description: This file contains the implementation of a default configuration class for WebSocket settings, including backpressure queues, throttling factors, and associated throttling configuration, for the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: DefaultWebsocketConfig
classes.description: Immutable implementation of WebsocketConfig interface, encapsulating WebSocket configuration parameters.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a WebsocketConfig instance from a given Config object.

methods.name: getSubscriberBackpressureQueueSize
methods.description: Getter for the subscriber backpressure queue size.

methods.name: getPublisherBackpressureBufferSize
methods.description: Getter for the publisher backpressure buffer size.

methods.name: getThrottlingRejectionFactor
methods.description: Getter for the throttling rejection factor.

methods.name: getThrottlingConfig
methods.description: Getter for the throttling configuration object.
